name: Overview
description: The numbers this deployment is licensed on: cores deployed, worker-node cores, data ingested and events per second, per UTC day.

config.name: Cores deployed
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The 7 UTC days to today whatever the picker shows. No rows read as NULL, never 0.
SELECT maxOrNull(value) AS "Cores deployed"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'cores_deployed' AND _org_id = '' AND day >= toDate(now(), 'UTC') - 6

config.name: Worker-node cores
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The 7 UTC days to today whatever the picker shows. No rows read as NULL, never 0.
SELECT maxOrNull(value) AS "Worker-node cores"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'node_cores' AND _org_id = '' AND day >= toDate(now(), 'UTC') - 6

config.name: Data ingested
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The 7 UTC days to today whatever the picker shows. No rows read as NULL, never 0.
SELECT maxOrNull(value) AS "Data ingested"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'ingested_bytes' AND _org_id = '' AND day >= toDate(now(), 'UTC') - 6

config.name: Events per second
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The 7 UTC days to today whatever the picker shows. No rows read as NULL, never 0.
SELECT maxOrNull(value) AS "Events per second"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'events_per_second' AND _org_id = '' AND day >= toDate(now(), 'UTC') - 6

config.name: Cores deployed
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The day's highest minute of the CPU requested by the containers the usage rollup counts.
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS ts, value AS "Cores deployed"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'cores_deployed' AND _org_id = '' AND $__dateFilter(day)
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Worker-node cores
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The day's highest minute of the logical CPUs on the nodes running those containers.
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS ts, value AS "Worker-node cores"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'node_cores' AND _org_id = '' AND $__dateFilter(day)
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Data ingested
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The day's decoded payload bytes accepted at the first hop.
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS ts, value AS "Data ingested"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'ingested_bytes' AND _org_id = '' AND $__dateFilter(day)
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Events per second
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The day's busiest minute, as its average events loaded per second.
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS ts, value AS "Events per second"
FROM dfe.usage_daily FINAL
WHERE metric = 'events_per_second' AND _org_id = '' AND $__dateFilter(day)
ORDER BY ts
